Compare institutional diffusion SPEED (project formation -> repeatable tender -> trained deployment -> verified completion), never existence/absence of reforms. Research ambition: 3% annual residential genuinely deep >=60% comparable annual energy savings, with 1.5% separate medium interventions; 2030 is a milestone test, NOT a cap that may be lowered for finance or present-day policy. If physical skill/installation capacity implies a later date (2032/33 etc.), model the attained year and TT implementation milestones explicitly. Climate rooms are separately counted by occupied serviced zones, not whole-building deep. Different PAS retention/adaptive strategies can meet Paris-aligned services/carbon envelope with different physical interventions.
